group_display_receipt.identity_boundary: Translate display append only; canonical item_name/getGameStartDescription and choice id/control remain unchanged.

actor_policy.external: Exact literal input; form=name only; never translated.
actor_policy.unseen: Only source-selected generic something/possessive and neuter pronoun; hidden identity fields rejected.
actor_policy.seen: Registered base_name_only IDs only; player ghosts, illusions, player and generated Pandemonium identities are excluded.
actor_policy.pronouns: Explicit original gender/form; plural English reflexive is upstream themself. Japanese pronouns are explicit translations rather than universal grammar rules.

item_policy.base: Only five source-grounded safe nouns in DESC_BASENAME; singular base noun irrespective of count.
item_policy.appearance: No appearances are registered yet; unsupported descriptors reject without revealing supplied identities.
item_policy.identified: No true item identities registered yet; unsupported descriptors reject without revealing supplied identities.

commands.policy: Caller passes actual native-resolved binding; configured bindings override defaults.

limitations: This registry covers twelve selected startup messages and bounded descriptor forms; it is not complete game text coverage.
Ordinary item identities, appearances, dynamic monster descriptors and renderer-wide grammar remain unregistered.
No gameplay, RNG, history, controls or native live-locale lifecycle is changed by this catalog.
